title: National Company Law Tribunal and Appellate Tribunal

content.overview: Sections 407 to 434 constitute the NCLT and NCLAT and transfer company jurisdiction to them.
content.glance: Sections 407 to 434 constitute the NCLT and NCLAT and transfer company jurisdiction to them.
content.study: The Tribunal hears oppression, schemes, reduction, refusal of transfer, class actions, and is the adjudicating authority under the IBC. Appeal lies to the NCLAT on the grounds in s. 421, and thereafter to the Supreme Court on a question of law under s. 423. Limitation and pre-deposit rules must be checked on the date of filing.
